raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Fixes #8028.

When using the Megatron backend with fused LM-head kernels (`use_fused_kernels=True`) and DDP parameter all-gather overlap (`overlap_param_gather=True`), training can fail on the second forward with `assert self.param_gather_handle is None`.

Fused kernels read the output weight directly, bypassing `output_layer.forward` and the DDP pre-hook that normally completes its parameter gather. If no other module pre-hook completes that bucket's gather, the pending handle causes the next gather dispatch to fail. We reproduce this with an untied output weight in its own DDP bucket; disabling parameter all-gather overlap avoids the failure.

### Design & Code Changes

Ensure the actual tied or untied output weight is ready immediately before either fused-kernel entry point. Use MCore's native readiness API when available; for the pinned MCore 0.19.2, register weak callbacks on the owning DDP buckets and follow their existing synchronization policy. This preserves dispatch ownership without retaining DDP objects or buffers. No configuration changes are required.

### Test

- Reproduced the failure on unpatched main; the overlap-disabled control passes.
- All patched GPU cases complete four optimizer steps, with **exact numerical agreement between parameter all-gather overlap on and off**. The patched overlap-off run also matches the unpatched control exactly.
- **23 CPU tests and all 14 pre-commit hooks pass**; `git diff --check` passes. Added tied/untied two-GPU regression cases to the existing model CI job.

### AI assistance

OpenAI Codex assisted with implementation, tests, GPU validation, and this description.

<details>
<summary>PR checklist</summary>

- [x] Checked [PRs referencing #8028](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+8028+in%3Abody) and [parameter-gather PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+param_gather): no other open PR addressing this fused-consumer readiness fix was found.
- [x] Followed the title format and contribution instructions.
- [x] Ran local checks and added CPU/GPU regression coverage.
- [x] Documented helper behavior; no user-facing API change.
- [x] Recipe submodule: not applicable.
- [ ] Request maintainer approval for GitHub CI through the documented channel.

</details>

### Validation details

<details>
<summary>GPU coverage and correctness checks</summary>

Tested against main at `4b26c788d41c`, using a tiny Qwen3 model in BF16 on 2–4 H20 GPUs with MCore 0.19.2. Each configuration runs four optimizer steps with parameter all-gather overlap on and off, using the same initialization, inputs, and seeds.

| Configuration | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| DP2/TP1/PP1 | Tied and untied output weights |
| DP2/TP1/PP1, packed input | Gradient accumulation across four microbatches |
| DP2/TP2/PP1, packed input | Tensor and sequence parallelism |
| DP2/TP1/PP2, packed input | Tied embedding/output weights across pipeline stages |

All configurations match exactly for loss, gradients, FP32 master weights, Adam states, and final model weights. Packed cases also compare output log probabilities and exercise `engine.train_batch()` through MCore's forward/backward schedule. Instrumentation confirms that the output weight's gather has completed before fused consumption; packed cases dispatch and complete each bucket's gather once per optimizer step across all four microbatches.

GPU coverage uses the native output processor with Triton and non-interleaved PP. Legacy dispatch and the optional native-readiness API have CPU coverage; VPP is not covered.

Local CPU command: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/utils/megatron/test_param_sync_on_cpu.py` — 23 passed.

</details>

+"""Exercise fused output readiness with a real engine, DDP, and distributed optimizer.
+
+Run with two GPUs and the repository's Megatron dependencies, without downloading
+model weights or data::
+
+    torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=2 \
+        tests/special_distributed/test_megatron_fused_param_sync.py \
+        --output /tmp/fused-ready --overlap 1 --expect pass
+
+The output contains per-step gradients, optimizer state, and the final model for
+comparison with an overlap-disabled run. ``--expect repro`` checks the original
+missing-wait failure when this script is run against an unpatched checkout.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import importlib.metadata
+import inspect
+import json
+import os
+import traceback
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from transformers import Qwen3Config, Qwen3ForCausalLM
+
+from verl.models.mcore import model_forward_fused as mff
+from verl.trainer.config import CheckpointConfig
+from verl.utils.megatron_utils import unwrap_model
+from verl.workers.config import HFModelConfig, McoreEngineConfig, McoreOptimizerConfig
+from verl.workers.engine.megatron.transformer_impl import MegatronEngineWithLMHead
+
+
+def emit(event, **fields):
+    """Emit a structured event with the current rank for distributed-run diagnostics."""
+    print("FUSED_READY " + json.dumps({"event": event, "rank": dist.get_rank(), **fields}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
+
+
+def cpu_tree(value):
+    """Copy nested tensor state to detached CPU snapshots that survive later updates."""
+    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+        return value.detach().cpu().clone()
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return {key: cpu_tree(child) for key, child in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value, tuple | list):
+        return [cpu_tree(child) for child in value]
+    return value
+
+
+def optimizer_state(engine):
+    """Snapshot each non-stub distributed optimizer's master weights and Adam state."""
+    return [
+        {
+            "master_float16": cpu_tree(opt.shard_fp32_from_float16_groups),
+            "master_float32": cpu_tree(opt.shard_fp32_groups),
+            "optimizer": cpu_tree(opt.optimizer.state_dict()),
+        }
+        for opt in getattr(engine.optimizer, "chained_optimizers", [engine.optimizer])
+        if not getattr(opt, "is_stub_optimizer", False)
+    ]
+
+
+def prepare_model(path, tied):
+    """Save a seeded tiny Qwen3 on rank zero and wait until all ranks can load it."""
+    if dist.get_rank() == 0:
+        assert not path.exists(), f"Refusing to overwrite {path}"
+        torch.manual_seed(20261019)
+        config = Qwen3Config(
+            vocab_size=256,
+            hidden_size=128,
+            intermediate_size=256,
+            num_hidden_layers=2,
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            num_key_value_heads=2,
+            head_dim=32,
+            max_position_embeddings=128,
+            tie_word_embeddings=tied,
+            attention_dropout=0.0,
+            bos_token_id=1,
+            eos_token_id=2,
+            pad_token_id=0,
+        )
+        config.architectures = ["Qwen3ForCausalLM"]
+        Qwen3ForCausalLM(config).save_pretrained(path)
+    dist.barrier()
+
+
+def make_engine(model_path, overlap):
+    """Initialize a DP2 fused engine with the requested parameter-gather overlap setting."""
+    model = HFModelConfig(
+        path=str(model_path),
+        load_tokenizer=False,
+        use_remove_padding=True,
+        use_fused_kernels=True,
+        enable_gradient_checkpointing=False,
+    )
+    config = McoreEngineConfig(
+        dtype="bfloat16",
+        seed=20261019,
+        param_offload=False,
+        optimizer_offload=False,
+        use_dynamic_bsz=False,
+        micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1,
+        max_token_len_per_gpu=32,
+        infer_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1,
+        infer_max_token_len_per_gpu=32,
+        use_remove_padding=True,
+        use_fused_kernels=True,
+        use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+        tensor_model_parallel_size=1,
+        pipeline_model_parallel_size=1,
+        context_parallel_size=1,
+        expert_model_parallel_size=1,
+        expert_tensor_parallel_size=1,
+        override_ddp_config={
+            "overlap_grad_reduce": True,
+            "overlap_param_gather": overlap,
+            "align_param_gather": False,
+            "bucket_size": 8192,
+        },
+        override_transformer_config={
+            "gradient_accumulation_fusion": False,
+            "hidden_dropout": 0.0,
+            "attention_dropout": 0.0,
+        },
+    )
+    optimizer = McoreOptimizerConfig(
+        lr=1e-3,
+        min_lr=1e-3,
+        lr_decay_style="constant",
+        total_training_steps=4,
+        lr_decay_steps=4,
+        lr_warmup_steps=0,
+        weight_decay=0.0,
+        clip_grad=1.0,
+        override_optimizer_config={"overlap_param_gather": overlap},
+    )
+    engine = MegatronEngineWithLMHead(model, config, optimizer, CheckpointConfig())
+    engine.initialize()
+    return engine
+
+
+def main():
+    """Run four training steps and assert either clean fused consumption or the baseline failure."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--overlap", type=int, choices=[0, 1], required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--tied", type=int, choices=[0, 1], default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--expect", choices=["pass", "repro"], required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"]))
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl")
+    assert dist.get_world_size() == 2

+"""Exercise parameter publication without CUDA/MCore; consumers use their actual source.
+
+The fake Work publishes new parameter bytes only when waited on, allowing these
+tests to detect stale numerical results as well as the next-step handle assertion.
+This is CPU lifecycle coverage, not a distributed GPU execution test.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import gc
+import importlib.util
+import sys
+import types
+import weakref

+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_test_verl_param_sync", ROOT / "verl/utils/megatron/param_sync.py")
+param_sync = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(param_sync)

+class _Work:
+    """Simulate a gather that publishes updated parameter values only when waited on."""
+
+    def __init__(self, bucket):
+        """Associate the simulated work with the bucket whose parameters it will publish."""
+        self.bucket = bucket
+
+    def wait(self):
+        """Publish the bucket's target values and count completion waits."""
+        self.bucket.waits += 1
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            for param in self.bucket.params:
+                param.copy_(self.bucket.target)
+
+
+class _Bucket:
+    """Model gather dispatch, completion, and parameter storage for CPU lifecycle tests."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *params):
+        """Initialize an idle bucket and target values for the supplied parameters."""
+        self.params = params
+        self.param_gather_dispatched = False
+        self.param_gather_handle = None
+        self.calls = []
+        self.waits = 0
+        self.target = torch.ones_like(params[0])
+
+    def start_param_sync(self):
+        """Dispatch a simulated gather, rejecting a handle left over from an earlier step."""
+        assert self.param_gather_handle is None, "previous parameter gather still in flight"
+        self.param_gather_handle = _Work(self)
+        self.param_gather_dispatched = True
+
+    def finish_param_sync(self, skip_next_bucket_dispatch=False):
+        """Record the prefetch policy, dispatch if needed, and drain the simulated gather."""
+        self.calls.append(skip_next_bucket_dispatch)
+        if not self.param_gather_dispatched:
+            self.start_param_sync()
+        if self.param_gather_handle is not None:
+            self.param_gather_handle.wait()
+            self.param_gather_handle = None
+
+
+class _DDP:
+    """Expose the DDP ownership and overlap settings used by readiness callbacks."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *params, overlap=True, align=False, optimizer_overlap=False):
+        """Place the supplied parameters in one bucket with configurable synchronization policy."""
+        self.module = torch.nn.ParameterList(params)
+        self.ddp_config = SimpleNamespace(overlap_param_gather=overlap, align_param_gather=align)
+        self.overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step = optimizer_overlap
+        self.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles = {"output_layer": object()}
+        self.bucket = _Bucket(*params)
+        self.param_to_bucket_group = dict.fromkeys(params, self.bucket)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("align,optimizer_overlap", [(False, False), (True, False), (False, True), (True, True)])
+def test_legacy_callback_preserves_ddp_prefetch_policy(align, optimizer_overlap):

+    param_sync.ensure_fused_weight_ready(weight)

+    def finish(bucket):

+        calls.append(bucket)

+def test_callback_does_not_retain_ddp_or_bucket():

+def _load_consumer(path, name, namespace):
+    """Load an actual consumer function into a CPU harness without importing its GPU dependencies."""
+    # Execute the real consumer body in a CPU dependency harness. The ordinary
+    # module import requires the CUDA/TE/Triton stack; its math is mocked here.
+    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / path).read_text())
+    node = next(n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)
+    future = ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__", names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")], level=0)
+    module = ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[future, node], type_ignores=[]))
+    exec(compile(module, path, "exec"), namespace)
+    return namespace[name]
+
+
+def _consumer(path_kind, weight, tied, ensure_ready):
+    """Run a native or legacy consumer with CPU loss math and return outputs and gradients."""
+    hidden = torch.tensor([[[0.5, -0.25]]], requires_grad=True)
+    labels = torch.tensor([0])
+
+    def linear_cross_entropy(hidden, weight, labels, *_args, **_kwargs):
+        """Compute reference log probabilities and entropy with differentiable CPU operations."""
+        logits = hidden.reshape(-1, 2) @ weight.t()
+        log_probs = logits.log_softmax(-1)
+        return log_probs[:, 0], -(log_probs.exp() * log_probs).sum(-1)
+
+    namespace = {
+        "torch": torch,
+        "OrderedDict": OrderedDict,
+        "CausalLMOutputForPPO": SimpleNamespace,
+        "ensure_fused_weight_ready": ensure_ready,
+        "linear_cross_entropy": linear_cross_entropy,
+        "parallel_state": SimpleNamespace(get_tensor_model_parallel_group=lambda: None),
+        "gather_from_sequence_parallel_region": lambda x: x,
+        "_gather_fused_hidden_states": lambda hidden, *_args: hidden,
+        "has_config_logger_enabled": lambda config: False,
+        "deprecate_inference_params": lambda ctx, params: ctx,
+    }
+    model = SimpleNamespace(
+        config=SimpleNamespace(sequence_parallel=False, moe_n_hash_layers=0),
+        training=True,
+        post_process=True,
+        mtp_process=False,
+        share_embeddings_and_output_weights=tied,
+        shared_embedding_or_output_weight=lambda: weight,
+        embedding=SimpleNamespace(word_embeddings=SimpleNamespace(weight=weight)),
+        output_layer=SimpleNamespace(weight=None if tied else weight),
+        _preprocess=lambda **kwargs: (hidden, None, None, None, None),
+        decoder=lambda **kwargs: hidden,
+    )
+    if path_kind == "native":
+        forward = _load_consumer("verl/models/mcore/model_forward_fused.py", "fused_output_processor", namespace)
+        output = forward(
+            hidden_states=hidden,
+            output_layer=model.output_layer,
+            output_weight=weight if tied else None,
+            labels=labels,
+            context=SimpleNamespace(temperature=1.0, impl_backend="triton"),
+            config=model.config,
+        )
+        log_probs = output.log_probs
+    else:
+        forward = _load_consumer("verl/models/mcore/model_forward_fused.py", "_fused_GPTModel_forward", namespace)
+        log_probs = forward(model, input_ids=labels, position_ids=labels, attention_mask=None, labels=labels).log_probs
+    return log_probs, torch.autograd.grad(log_probs.sum(), (hidden, weight))
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path_kind", ["native", "legacy"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tied", [False, True])

+def test_consumers_publish_fresh_weights_and_drain_handles_across_steps(path_kind, tied, ready_backend, monkeypatch):
+    """Match fresh-weight outputs and gradients while clearing each step's pending gather."""
+    weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(3, 2))

+        weight.native_ready = param_sync._DDPParamReadyCallback(ddp, ddp.bucket)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(param_sync, "PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR", "native_ready")

+        ddp.bucket.start_param_sync()

+        assert ddp.bucket.param_gather_handle is None
+        # MCore resets dispatch at the end of each optimizer step.
+        ddp.bucket.param_gather_dispatched = False
+    assert ddp.bucket.waits == 3

+_VERL_PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR = "_verl_ensure_param_ready_callback"
+
+
+def _is_graph_capturing():
+    """Return whether MCore is capturing a CUDA graph and must skip new collectives."""
+    from megatron.core.transformer import cuda_graphs
+
+    return cuda_graphs.is_graph_capturing()
+
+
+class _DDPParamReadyCallback:
+    """Use the owning DDP's synchronization policy without retaining its buffers."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ddp, bucket_group):
+        """Keep weak references to the bucket and the DDP instance that owns its schedule."""
+        self._ddp = weakref.ref(ddp)
+        self._bucket_group = weakref.ref(bucket_group)
+
+    def __call__(self):
+        """Complete the bucket's gather while preserving dispatch ownership.
+
+        DDP-owned schedules use the normal pre-hook policy. External schedules
+        only drain an existing handle, without starting or prefetching a gather.
+        """
+        ddp = self._ddp()
+        bucket_group = self._bucket_group()
+        if ddp is None or bucket_group is None:
+            return
+        if bucket_group.param_gather_dispatched and bucket_group.param_gather_handle is None:
+            return
+        # Match MCore's pre-hook: collectives must not be captured per microbatch.
+        if _is_graph_capturing():
+            return
+
+        ddp_owns_schedule = bool(ddp.remove_forward_pre_hook_handles)
+        if not ddp_owns_schedule:
+            # An external schedule owns dispatch. Drain an existing gather, but
+            # do not start a new gather or prefetch the next bucket on its behalf.
+            if bucket_group.param_gather_handle is not None:
+                bucket_group.finish_param_sync(skip_next_bucket_dispatch=True)
+            return
+
+        finish = getattr(ddp, "_finish_param_sync_for_bucket_group", None)
+        if finish is not None:
+            finish(bucket_group)
+        else:
+            # This is the policy used by older DDP forward pre-hooks.
+            bucket_group.finish_param_sync(
+                skip_next_bucket_dispatch=(
+                    ddp.ddp_config.align_param_gather or ddp.overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step
+                )
+            )
+
+
+def register_ddp_param_ready_callbacks(model_chunks):
+    """Attach compatibility callbacks after wrapping model chunks in DDP.
+
+    Native MCore callbacks take precedence. Re-wrapping replaces our callbacks
+    (or removes them when overlap is disabled), so parameters cannot retain an
+    old bucket owner. Frozen parameters without a DDP buffer are left unmarked.
+    """
+    from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallel
+
+    if not isinstance(model_chunks, list | tuple):
+        model_chunks = [model_chunks]
+    for ddp in model_chunks:
+        if not isinstance(ddp, DistributedDataParallel):
+            continue
+        for param in ddp.module.parameters():
+            if hasattr(param, _VERL_PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR):
+                delattr(param, _VERL_PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR)
+        if not ddp.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather:
+            continue
+        if not hasattr(ddp, "param_to_bucket_group"):
+            raise RuntimeError("Fused parameter readiness requires DDP.param_to_bucket_group with AG overlap.")
+
+        callbacks = {}
+        for param, bucket_group in ddp.param_to_bucket_group.items():
+            if PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR is not None and callable(getattr(param, PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR, None)):
+                continue
+            key = id(bucket_group)
+            if key not in callbacks:
+                callbacks[key] = _DDPParamReadyCallback(ddp, bucket_group)
+            setattr(param, _VERL_PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR, callbacks[key])
+
+
+def ensure_fused_weight_ready(weight):
+    """Publish the actual weight before a fused kernel reads its parameter storage."""
+    if _mcore_ensure_params_ready is not None:
+        _mcore_ensure_params_ready([weight])
+    callback = getattr(weight, _VERL_PARAM_READY_CALLBACK_ATTR, None)
+    if callback is not None:
+        callback()
